---
title: Percent Change From Initial Price to New Price
output: html_document
---

\begin{align*}
s &= \text{scale factor}\\
i &= \text{initial (old) price}\\
n &= \text{new price}\\
c &= \text{percent change (decimal form)}
\end{align*}


$$s = \frac{n}{i}$$

$$i = \frac{n}{s}$$

$$n = si$$

$$c=|s-1|$$

* If new price is **more** than initial price, the percent change is a percent **increase**, and $s=c+1$, and $c=s-1$, and:

$$c ~=~ \frac{n}{i}-1$$

$$i = \frac{n}{1+c}$$

$$n = i\cdot(1+c)$$


* If new price is **less** than initial price, the percent change is a percent **decrease**, and $s=1-c$, and $c=1-s$, and:

$$c ~=~ 1-\frac{n}{i}$$

$$i = \frac{n}{1-c}$$

$$n = i\cdot(1-c)$$
